slides.headline: They want him to betray his own father.
slides.sub: William Frederick Yeames, And When Did You Last See Your Father?, 1878

slides.headline: England is at war. Soldiers search a house for the *father*.
They stand his small *son* on a stool before them.
His hands are behind his back. He stands very *straight*.
An officer asks him *gently*: when did you last see your father?
Beside him, a clerk waits to write down every *word*.
Around them, armed soldiers fill the *room*.
Behind the boy, his sister waits her *turn*, in tears.
Behind her, a woman stares toward the table, pale with *fear*.
The women are held back. They can only *watch*.
He was taught never to *lie*. The truth betrays his father.
Yeames never shows his answer. What would *you* say?
